text: dsh-fa-rtl 是面向 DSH Web 聊天界面的波斯语 RTL 排版插件。它通过浏览器端样式为聊天文本块启用逐块双向文本检测与起始方向对齐，让波斯语段落靠右显示，同时保留英文内容与代码块的左到右布局，并按单元格处理表格。适合在 DSH Web 中阅读或发送波斯语消息的用户。实现未读取 API 密钥或调用运行时外部服务。

dsh-fa-rtl adds automatic right-to-left layout for Persian text in DSH Web chats. Its browser stylesheet detects direction per text block and aligns it accordingly, while code blocks stay left-to-right. It needs no API key or runtime external service.
想让 DSH 聊天里的波斯语段落自动靠右排版。
DSH Web 显示波斯语时文字方向不对，有办法自动调整吗？
Can Persian chat messages in DSH align right automatically while keeping code left-to-right?
dsh-fa-rtl 的功能「聊天文本自动 RTL 排版」：插件加载时向页面插入样式，对聊天段落、列表和表格等文本元素按首个强字符决定双向文本方向，并按起始方向对齐；代码块不在样式目标中。

dsh-fa-rtl README · dsh-fa-rtl：**Right-to-left display for Persian (Farsi) chat messages in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.**

[فارسی](README.fa.md) | English

Persian answers from the model — and your own Persian messages — render right-to-left and right-aligned, while English paragraphs, code blocks, and tables keep their original left-to-right layout. It is a pure DSH plugin: no modification to the application's files, no build toolchain, nothing to configure after install.

dsh-fa-rtl README · How it works：`unicode-bidi: plaintext` (CSS Writing Modes 4) lets **each text block** choose its own direction from the block's first strong character — a paragraph starting with Persian renders RTL and right-aligns; a paragraph starting with English is unchanged. Consequences:

dsh-fa-rtl README · How it works：- Mixed answers (Persian prose + code + tables) render correctly: prose RTL, `<pre>` code deliberately untouched (stays LTR), table cells per-cell, list markers flip with their list.
- The selector scopes only to stable `data-*` attributes that `dsh-client-ui-chat` emits on its flow items (`data-chat-flow-kind`, `data-chat-group-part`, `data-turn-process-answer`). Build-time hashed class names are never referenced, so the plugin survives UI updates. If an attribute ever changes, the CSS simply stops matching — it cannot break the app.
dsh-fa-rtl README · Install：Requires DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 with a web composition (`desktop` or `web` profile). Any Chromium/Electron ≥ 105 works.

dsh-fa-rtl README · From the DSH Web UI：Open the **Plugins** page in the sidebar and install the bundle from this repository's GitHub address (`github:mehdinikzad68/dsh-fa-rtl`). Installation runs `pnpm` in the profile directory and enables the bundle by default.

dsh-fa-rtl README · From the CLI：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:mehdinikzad68/dsh-fa-rtl

dsh-fa-rtl README · or, for the web profile:：dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-fa-rtl
```

Installation normally enables the bundle automatically; if not, toggle it on from the Plugins page. Restart the app once if your profile applies patches only at startup.
dsh-fa-rtl README · From an agent session：Ask the agent to use the `plugin_manager` tool with action `install_bundle` and the GitHub spec. Each management call requires your approval.

dsh-fa-rtl README · Local development (no installation)：Clone the repo and point a profile patch row at the **module file** (ESM cannot import a directory). In `<profile-dir>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: fa-rtl
      name: 'C:\path\to\dsh-fa-rtl\lib\index.js'
```

dsh-fa-rtl README · Verify：1. Ask the model something in Persian — the Persian text renders RTL and right-aligned; numbers and punctuation sit correctly; code stays LTR.
2. Browser console (or DevTools) shows: `[dsh-fa-rtl] active — Persian chat text now renders right-to-left`
3. `<head>` contains a `<style data-plugin="dsh-fa-rtl">` tag.
4. Settings → Plugins shows no synchronization error for the bundle.

dsh-fa-rtl README · Uninstall：Remove the bundle from the Plugins page or with `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-fa-rtl` (installed route), or delete the `fa-rtl` insert block from `cordis.patch.yml` (local route). The module system removes the plugin's stylesheet when the entry is disabled.

dsh-fa-rtl README · Package layout：```
dsh-fa-rtl/
├── package.json        # manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client declaration
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle patch: registers the fa-rtl Loader row on install
├── lib/index.js        # Host half (Node): imports cleanly, mounts as a Cordis plugin

dsh-fa-rtl README · Extend：- Want more surfaces RTL (e.g. `ask_user_question` cards)? Widen the scope selector list in [`lib/client.js`](lib/client.js) and save — HMR hot-swaps the bundle, or restart once.
- Want *forced* RTL for everything (even English text)? Replace `unicode-bidi: plaintext` with `direction: rtl` in the same file.

dsh-fa-rtl README · Known limitations：- A paragraph that *starts* with a Latin word (e.g. «VS Code را نصب کن») resolves LTR in auto mode — the same behavior as `dir="auto"` everywhere on the web; the Persian runs inside still order correctly.
- Overflowing wide tables keep their physical margins; very wide Persian tables may align slightly differently.
- Question cards (`ask_user_question`) and some side bars are intentionally out of scope for v1.
